Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

schema.description: A recipient's delivery layer tells the sender that it durably holds a message the sender asked to be receipted, by echoing the delivery id the sender stamped on it. Fire-and-forget: no response, and no receipt of a receipt.

confirms.description: The delivery id the sender stamped on the message — the TSP binding envelope's `deliveryId`, or the DIDComm binding's `delivery_id` header — echoed exactly.

schema.title: Messaging — Receipt — payload
